exposure: induction of labor following successful external cephalic version
expectant management following successful external cephalic version
cohort: Women who underwent successful external cephalic version, divided into groups receiving immediate induction of labor (n=57) or expectant management (n=341).
finding: Immediate induction of labor after successful external cephalic version was not shown to influence cesarean delivery rates compared to expectant management.
mod_finding: Immediate induction of labor following successful external cephalic version did not influence cesarean delivery rates.
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery: 40 1/7 weeks for expectant management group vs. 38 4/7 weeks for induction group.
